browserTTS.scope: Browser API calls/on-off/zh-CN only. Native engine errors are environment limitations, not successful speech playback.

checks.name: Exact integration scope; every Phase 3 base file unchanged except the two car-navigation insertions
All four desktop sizes, toolbar-reduced heights, narrow landscape and 390×844: four tabs, no horizontal overflow, every control reachable
Native-click start/stop sequence, held pedals, D/S acceleration and both moving needles, P/R/N/off/handbrake/belt guards
Seatbelt, reverse, neutral and acceleration guards
Sunny/three rain levels/snow mutually exclusive, real snow elements, wipers, day/night, headlights, signals/hazard and fog visual state
Air temperature display, all fan levels, window, simulated music state, lock, horn, steering and browser-TTS on/off
Real Chromium 125% page zoom: five viewport/toolbar cases, CDP zoom=1.25 scale=1, footer/pedals/all controls reachable
Desktop and 390×844 true 3D → cockpit → 3D navigation; original three actions/WebGL and Xiaoyi MP3 playing+ended; no fallback or shared snow
